latest_news.headline: Iran formally rejects US 15-point ceasefire plan, issues 5-point counterproposal

Counterproposal demands: (1) war reparations, (2) Hormuz sovereignty recognition, (3) end to sanctions, (4) withdrawal from Gulf bases, (5) apology. Massive gap with US demands. But White House says plan 'never confirmed' and calls rejection narrative 'speculative.'

latest_news.headline: White House denies Iran rejected plan: 'they have not' — plan details 'speculative'
latest_news.text: Press Secretary Leavitt pushes back on rejection narrative. Says Trump 'willing to listen' and engaged in 'constructive discussions.' Plan details reported by media called 'not entirely factual.' Both sides now denying the rejection narrative exists.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan formally delivers Trump's 15-point plan to Iran — Sharif 'ready and honoured'
